Annie
Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.
Matilda
A little girl develops extraordinary mental abilities, despite neglectful parents and a brutal headmistress.
A Knight's Tale
An English commoner (Heath Ledger) dons the armor of a dead jouster and, with the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), competes against nobles in 14th-century France.
10 Things I Hate About You
A pretty, popular student is not allowed to date until her rebellious older sister gets a suitor of her own.
What a Girl Wants
A vivacious teenager (Amanda Bynes) leaves New York in order to meet her estranged father (Colin Firth) in London.
The Right Stuff
The selection and training of the first U.S. astronauts take place amid political maneuvering and media hype.
Crisis
A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance.
Starbuck
More than 140 people sue a fertility clinic to reveal the name of the sperm donor (Patrick Huard) whose frequent contributions resulted in 533 offspring.
Step Dogs

Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home.
I Can Only Imagine 2

After the success of "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream with sold-out arenas, a devoted fan base, and a thriving career. However, his past soon threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son.
The Unbreakable Boy

When Scott and Teresa learn their son, Austin, is autistic and has brittle bone disease, they worry about his future. However, with Scott's growing faith and Austin's incredible spirit, they find joy, gratitude and courage in the most trying times.
The Goonies
Young misfits find a 17th-century pirate's treasure map and set out to discover the treasure in order to save their neighborhood from redevelopment.
E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
A boy's close encounter with an alien stranded on Earth leads to a unique friendship in Steven Spielberg's Oscar-winning film.
Shazam!

Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.
Charlie's Angels
Three private detectives try to rescue a kidnapped computer pro whose voice-ID software would threaten global security.
Top Gun

For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.
The Adjustment Bureau
After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves.
